json_schema.title: grains.append
json_schema.description: Append a value to a list in the grains config file. If the grain doesn't exist, the grain key is added and the value is appended to the new grain as a list item

key.ui:title: Key
key.ui:description: The grain key to be appended to

val.ui:title: Value
val.ui:description: The value to append to the grain key

convert.ui:title: Convert
convert.ui:description: If conver is True, convert non-list contents into a list. If convert is False and the grain contains non-list contents, an error is given. Defaults to False

delimiter.ui:title: Delimiter
delimiter.ui:description: The key can be a nested dict key. Use this parameter to specify the delimiter you use, instead of the default `:`. You can now append values to a list in nested dictionary grains. If the list doesn't exist at this level, it will be created
